bays.note: THE MODULES MOUNT ON THE FRONT PLATE, NOT INSIDE IT. The front view punches four openings 3.54in [90] across and 1.42in [36] tall; a module's 108.97 plate covers its opening, its thumb-knobs landing in the pair of holes either side (3.91in, 99.4 apart on the panel drawings), and only the adapter block behind passes through. So each bay is the module plate's 108.97 x 35.05, centred on its opening, and `opening` is the hole an empty slot shows. Adjacent plates stand about 1.0 apart. FOUR MODULES SPAN 440 ACROSS A 430 BODY: the outer plates overhang the body line by 5.0 onto the flat flange - the plate is one flat sheet, so nothing stops them - which is why this front view is the whole plate, 482.6, and lint L43's warning that a rack-wide face still has its ears in it is true and left standing: here the ears are the same flat sheet the modules overlap. Bays are in the plate's own frame, 0 at its left end. every FHD cassette and adapter panel this library models is in every bay's `accepts`. FS states it on this datasheet's features list ('Compatible with all FHD cassettes and panels') and prints the same loading list with every one of them as fs/fhd-1ufce does; the module face is one 4.29 x 1.38in (108.97 x 35.05) envelope.

chassis.note: spec table: 1.73 x 19.00 x 11.17in (44.0 x 482.6 x 283.6). The top view dimensions the body behind the front plate 16.93in [430] across - the figure the 2026-09-11 intake could not place, and which is this width: the plate's small edge notches in the front view sit 26.3 in from each end, (482.6 - 430) / 2. Depth 283.6 is the top view's body line; the side view's 11.6in [295.1] includes the front plate and knobs.

cutouts.note: front view at 2400 dpi, 19.47 px/mm on the 482.6 plate (the plate then reads 44.34 against 44.0, 0.8%), taken on stroke centres: openings 89.74 x 36.26, centres at 75.81 186.29 296.57 406.85 of the plate (pitches 110.48 110.28 110.28), top edge 4.26. FS prints 3.54in [89.8] across; 1.42in on the tilt-down sibling. The front view is the plate, so these are its own coordinates.

ears.note: NOT A SEPARATE PART HERE: the plate's own ends, 26.3 each side of the 430 body (the notches in the front view), carry the rack holes. The front view includes them and no common/rack-ear@1 is placed; the other five faces are the 430 body.

envelope-faces.note: rear, top, bottom, left and right are the envelope from `chassis`; the rear cable entries and grommets the datasheet lists are not dimensioned. See `gaps`.

interior.note: the two slack spools drawn behind openings 1 and 4 in the front view are inside the tray, seen through an empty slot; a seated module hides them. Not drawn.

method.note: FROM THE VENDOR'S VECTOR DRAWING. Every figure is read off p4 of fhd-1ufmt-n-fiber- enclosure-datasheet.pdf (front, side and top views, inches with millimetres), rendered at 2400 dpi where it needs measuring; what the drawing does not show is estimated below or left undrawn.
